summary_4_lines: On Explore banks they scrolled from the loan form down to the results, then said they have to change a button to “compare banks.”
The visible actions at that moment are “See options” on the form and “Apply once” on the table.
They treated that action as the next copy change, then moved on.
This continues the previous recording’s talk of “compare all and apply in one shot.”
cards.pinpoint: They said the primary action button must be changed to “compare banks” after scrolling from the loan form down to the results.
cards.on_screen_object: See options / Apply once on Explore banks
quotes_sample: We have to change a button to compare banks.
We have come down from here. We have to change a button to compare banks. Okay, next.
Compare all and apply in one shot
related_discussion_one_liners: They asked how many options they have and typed property agreement value 60,00,000 (ASR: “60 lakhs of properties”).
They clicked Regular (Purpose) after starting on Top-up.
Previous recording: compare-all-and-apply-in-one-shot and banks competing; cognitive-load / left-to-right reading — not a separate issue here.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is a CTA label change to “compare banks” on See options / Apply once, not the banks-vs-lenders vocabulary debate, the tabs-to-table gap, or the edit-form control.

summary_4_lines: They said the page talks about banks, but the list is lenders, including NBFCs that are not banks.
Ordinary people hear “bank”; people who know the product know NBFCs exist.
They asked where to use a neutral word (“lenders”) versus bank-specific wording.
They left it for now: it is “just a term,” and they will watch real users with a plugin.
cards.pinpoint: They said the page talks banks while the list is lenders including NBFCs, and asked where to use the neutral word lenders.
cards.on_screen_object: Page title Explore banks / Bank type filter vs Lenders column
related_discussion_one_liners: Uncle / 2 lakh need vs 1 lakh income; credit-card user who “uses a lender” without knowing the word.
Plugin to record customer video, then do small wording changes.
They closed with “It's just a term. Yes, it's okay. For now we don't know what to do.” — deferral, not “this is fine forever.”
Sandwich / cooking talk later is about the tabs, not this wording.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is vocabulary (banks vs lenders / NBFCs) on title, Bank type filter, and Lenders column, not which CTA to label “compare banks,” not spacing, and not the edit-form button.

cards.issue_title: Too much gap between the result tabs and the table
summary_4_lines: They liked the results header block, then said there is a little gap between the buttons and the table, then a little more, then “but it’s too much.”
On screen that is the Overview / Charges / Other charges tabs (and Apply once) sitting above the Lenders table with a large empty band.
They also said the header colour is different so they “don’t know the header.”
cards.pinpoint: They said the gap between the result tabs/buttons and the table is too large, and the header colour does not read as a header.
cards.on_screen_object: Space between Overview/Charges/Other charges (and Apply once) and the Lenders table
quotes_sample: There is a little gap between the buttons and the table.
The color is also different. We don't know the header.
related_discussion_one_liners: Lender column: “I don't know if it's high or low” (sorted Rate 8.75% upward).
Chrome-circle / tab switcher talk that follows is a different question (whether tabs should cover only the four data columns).
They later said that tab-scope design is not a problem (“Done. It's perfect.”) — not this issue.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is spacing and header colour between the result tabs and the Lenders table, not CTA copy, not banks-vs-lenders wording, and not needing a button after edit.

cards.issue_title: Form goes up / results down — they need a button
summary_4_lines: After clicking **edit** on the results, the loan form came back above the table.
They asked what edit does, then said they need a button because the form went up and the answer went down and they did not see how.
They compared it to Myntra: cards are not identical; you change selection in a strict way; going back up should be an explicit control.
cards.pinpoint: After edit brought the loan form back above the table, they said they need a button because the form went up and the answer went down without a clear control.
cards.on_screen_object: Edit inputs control next to Overview/Charges/Other charges
quotes_sample: Form goes up, answer goes down.
How did it go up? I need a button.
If you go to Mintra or something…
related_discussion_one_liners: Tabs should live where edit is; then “no edit, let it scroll by itself.”
Myntra analogy: cards are not same-to-same; you change selection in a strict way.
After the button line they agreed the four data columns belong to the tab, five tabs to judge a home loan (rate, loan, tenure, EMI, processing / legal charges).
Sandwich analogy: cut and it fitted — later talk is praise of the tab model, not a second defect.
They selected all banks then deselected.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is needing a clear button for form-up / answer-down after Edit inputs, not the tabs-to-table gap, not “compare banks” CTA wording, and not banks vs lenders / NBFCs.
